repos.name: headroomlabs-ai/headroom
repos.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
repos.one_liner: A token-optimization middleware that compresses logs, files, and RAG chunks for LLM efficiency.
bullets: Python-based library, proxy, and MCP server architecture.
Reduces token consumption by 20-95% for coding and JSON data.
Maintains LLM output quality while significantly lowering inference costs.
Essential infrastructure for scaling agentic workflows and RAG pipelines.

bullets: Features a sophisticated stack including sandboxes, persistent memory, and subagent management.

Designed for complex, multi-step automation tasks requiring long-term planning.
Provides a robust framework for building autonomous research and development agents.

repos.name: microsoft/tgrep
repos.description: Trigram-indexed grep with a client/server architecture for fast regex search in large codebases locally
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, trigram-indexed grep tool with client/server architecture for local codebase searching.
bullets: Written in Rust for memory safety and high-speed execution.
Utilizes a client/server model to enable rapid regex searches across massive local codebases.
Implements trigram indexing to drastically reduce search latency compared to standard grep.
Ideal for developers managing large-scale repositories and complex code navigation.
